subject: gk
question:
Which of the following statements regarding the Dronacharya Award is/are correct?

1) It carries a cash prize of ₹10 lakhs and features a gold statue of Guru Dronacharya.

2) O.M. Nambiar was honored with the first Dronacharya Award in 1985 for outstanding coaching.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only 2 is Correct**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Dronacharya Award** is presented annually by the Government of India to sports coaches for their outstanding contributions to sports coaching.
 
• **Statement 1 is incorrect** as the Dronacharya Award carries a cash prize of ₹15 lakhs, along with a bronze statuette of Guru Dronacharya and a scroll of honor, not a gold statue.
 
• **Statement 2 is correct** as O.M. Nambiar, who was the coach of legendary athlete P.T. Usha, was honored with the first Dronacharya Award in 1985.
 
• The award was instituted in **1985** to recognize excellence in coaching and motivating athletes to achieve success in international sports.
 
• The Dronacharya Award is considered one of the highest honors for sports coaching in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Statement 1 (Incorrect):**

 
 
• The cash prize for the Dronacharya Award was increased from ₹5 lakhs to ₹15 lakhs in 2020 by the Government of India.
 
• The award includes a bronze statuette of Guru Dronacharya, not a gold statue as mentioned in the statement.
 
• The statuette symbolizes the legendary teacher Dronacharya from the Mahabharata, who was known for his mentorship and training of the Kauravas and Pandavas in warfare and archery.
 
 
 
• **Statement 2 (Correct):**
 
 
• O.M. Nambiar, the first recipient of the Dronacharya Award in 1985, is widely recognized for coaching P.T. Usha, one of India’s greatest athletes.
 
• He played a crucial role in shaping P.T. Usha’s career, helping her achieve international success, including at the Asian Games and the Olympics.
 
 
 
• **About the Dronacharya Award:**
 
 
• The award is conferred in two categories: **Lifetime Contribution** and **Regular Coaching**.
 
• Nominees are selected by a committee based on their contributions to the development of athletes and their achievements at national and international levels.
 
• It is one of four prominent sports awards in India, alongside the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna (now renamed Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna), Arjuna Award, and Dhyan Chand Award.
